what_it_is: Target Number to be Trained through New Master of Science in Holistic Palliative Care Programme

sections.label: Palliative care workforce training
sections.summary: Graduates can work in healthcare institutions and community care organisations providing end-of-life support, with palliative care training integrated into undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Graduates can be employed in healthcare institutions and community care organisations that provide patients with end-of-life support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Workforce training and development is a key enabler to the Ministry of Health's national palliative care strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: First, palliative care has been integrated into the local undergraduate training curriculum for medicine, nursing, pharmacy and various allied health disciplines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Second, postgraduate training programmes in palliative care are offered by the Agency of Integrated Care's Learning Network, healthcare organisations and Institutes of Higher Learning.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Healthcare professionals can tap on training grants and scholarships when they attend such programmes.

sections.label: Nursing palliative care specialisation
sections.summary: In nursing, there is a specialisation on the Advanced Diploma in Nursing (Palliative Care).

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In particular, for example, in nursing, they have the specialisation on the Advanced Diploma in Nursing (Palliative Care).
